fork.statement: Arkansas cannot simply abolish personal income tax and property tax by leaning harder on revenue streams it already has — full dual abolition fails Base@16y integration and fails again after feeder demotion.

regressivity_surface.rule: If a proposed replacement merely shifts burden onto ordinary households through higher prices or regressive consumption taxes, surface that explicitly.
findings: Prior slice: sales-tax-heavy IIT swap is a burden rename without household protections.
Integration: many-small-mechanisms end state is more resilient than one giant tax swap; renter incidence through rents remains NEE.
